name: zinput_global_state_constructor
description: zInput_GlobalState::Constructor initializes the static bind-map overlay lifetime fields: clears the auxiliary/block list, free list, stack head, reserved field, and depth, then sets the overlay block size to 8.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput global-state/bootstrap pass.
The current source keeps the original contiguous global-state storage as named globals instead of rebuilding a duplicate aggregate storage mirror.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x471ab0 writes zero to original offsets 0x41f8, 0x41fc, 0x4204, 0x4200, and 0x4208 relative to g_zInput_GlobalState storage and writes block size 8 at offset 0x41f4.
Push/pop overlay Binary Ninja evidence maps the touched addresses to the bind-map overlay auxiliary list, free list, stack head, reserved field, and depth fields modeled in source.
The native lifecycle smoke verifies constructor return value, zeroing of all modeled lifecycle fields, and block-size initialization.
